title: Electrostatics
content: Electrostatics is the study of electric charge at rest.

title: Electrodynamics
content: Electrodynamics is the study of moving electric charges and their interaction with magnetic and electric fields.

title: Electric Current
content: Flow of charges is called an electric current.

title: Conductor
content: The substance which has plenty of free electrons is called a conductor.

title: Insulator
content: The substance which has very few (or) no free electrons is called an insulator.

title: Semiconductor
content: Some substances which contain a moderate amount of free electrons are called semiconductors.

title: Induction
content: Induction is the process of charging a conductor without any contact with the charged body.
